messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: cont-batch streaming lanes in us-west-2 showing p99 latency spike. Current p99 ~4.8s (SLO 1.2s). Auto-page oncall.

alex: oncall here — I see the spike. Grafana shows contbatch packer queue depth x6 on a subset of hosts. Streaming lanes show stalls and partial frames.

sara: logs show high variance in incoming sequence lengths on /chat/stream. Lots of short requests followed by very long ones, causing large padding and long pack assembly times.

jamal: scheduler metrics indicate fairness skew. One tenant's long sessions are monopolizing pack windows. preemption_count for streaming workers is 0 for the affected host pool.

maria: customer-impact: CS reports multiple customers with timeouts in last 7m. Telemetry: 3.2% reqs >3s, error-rate +0.6% in usw2. Noticing some 502s from the proxy where streaming times out.

alex: quick mitigations candidate list: 1) reduce contbatch.max_batch_size 64->16 2) enable preemptive_shed on packer 3) evict old KV entries to relieve memory pressure 4) route long-seq sessions to degraded pool. Which can we flip in <2m?

sara: batch_size downshift is fast via config service. Command: `redwoodctl config set contbatch.max_batch_size=16 --region usw2 --scope prod` — should propagate in ~30s. preemptive_shed toggle I want to canary at 10% first.

jamal: KV eviction is quick: run TTL on contbatch_kv prefixes. Example: ```redis-cli -h kv-usw2 EVAL "for k in redis.call('keys', ARGV[1]) do redis.call('expire', k, 1) end" 0 "contbatch_kv:*"``` will age entries; takes ~10s to reclaim memory. I'll run after batch_size change.

ops-bot: Runbook action: reduce max_batch_size -> 16 (canary 25% hosts). Enable preemptive_shed (canary 10%). Schedule KV eviction. No rolling restart required for config change.

alex: I'm kicking off the batch_size rollback to 16 now on canary set. Watching packer latency and stream frames.

sara: on canaries: packing latency dropped ~55% and p95 decreased. p99 still high on non-canary hosts. Partial improvement.

jamal: enabling preemptive_shed canary (10%) now — should allow streaming reqs to preempt long assembly.

maria: CS notified affected customers with templated message. Incident start: 1764543210 UTC.

sara: after preemptive_shed canary, those nodes show queue depth down ~40% and fewer stream stall traces. Nice.

alex: rolling batch_size change to 100% in increments (+25% every 15s). Monitoring for error-rate regressions.

ops-bot: Rollout 50% complete. No error bump observed.

jamal: kicking off KV eviction now to free stale KV segments referenced by packer. Memory pressure on hosts trending down.

maria: support noise declining. Backend p99 now ~1.6s cluster-wide; two host pools still show hotspots with p99 ~2.8s.

alex: those two hotspots need scheduler fairness tweak. Proposal: increase fair_share_window 1s->3s to smooth packing and prevent rapid monopolization. That will be a config change; need to schedule low-traffic window for rollout.

sara: long-term proposals for remediation: 1) dedicated long-seqlen fleet and route heavy sessions 2) soft request max_sequence and adaptive backpressure before packer 3) improve packer to adaptive-bin by seqlen to avoid worst-case padding 4) add preemptive metrics and alerts for packer starvation.

jamal: creating follow-up ticket: INC-1764543210-FIX with host IDs, traces, and reproduction steps. Suggest synthetic mixed-seq canary test to validate fixes.

alex: incident state: mitigated — cluster-wide p99 ~1.4s after rollouts and eviction. Customer impact window ~7m; small set of customers experienced degraded streaming. Moving to post-incident review and handoff.

maria: adding final notes to customer-impact doc and notifying CS leads. Please file postmortem and remediation tasks within 48h. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Thread will be archived; handoff to postmortem channel if follow-up tasks created.
